summary.en: Another day, another case as Kogoro stumbles upon the death of the President of a popular apparel company. Just why would the President be wearing an unflattering facial mask if she had been expecting company? It's just one of the many perplexing elements of a most unusual case.

suspects: Takeo Izumi, Chihiro Kojima, and Juro Yoshioka
suspectsZh: 泉武夫、小岛千寻与吉冈十郎
